stem.text: Two objects move towards each other along the same straight line.

stem.alt: Two circles on a dashed horizontal line, each with a horizontal arrow: the left circle's arrow points right, the right circle's arrow points left.

stem.text: After colliding, the two objects stick together and are stationary.

A.text: The total kinetic energy of the two objects does not change during the collision.

B.text: The total momentum of the two objects before the collision is zero.

C.text: The two objects have equal mass.

D.text: The two objects have the same speed before the collision.
